newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Oct 3.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Oct 3:

WASHINGTON - An emergency summit of Israeli and Palestinian leaders hosted by President Clinton ended with an agreement to continue talking but without any narrowing of the explosive differences that plunged their peoples into armed conflict last week.
WASHINGTON - House Speaker Newt Gingrich has harsh words for Washington's Mayor Marion Barry, calling him "a great disappointment".
WASHINGTON - Democrats speak with increasing optimism about their chances of recapturing the Senate and a major reason is the kind of Republican candidates they are running against.

KABUL, Afghanistan - In the five days since the radical Islamic Taleban militia ousted Afghanistan's government, Kabul's residents have seen people being publicly beaten and humiliated for petty crimes, women barred from workplaces and girls told not to go to school.

LOS ANGELES - Almost a year to the day since O.J. Simpson was acquitted of murder charges, retired police detective Mark Fuhrman pleaded no contest to a perjury charge stemming from sworn court statements that he had not used a racial epithet in the past 10 years.
